# Repository-wide Copilot instructions

<!-- topgun1111-engineering-policy:v1 -->
Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) in full before substantial work; it is the canonical shared engineering policy. Honor relevant project-specific instructions and surface conflicts.

- The owner is a beginner-level AI-assisted developer working primarily from Android. Explain important concepts plainly and recommend materially better approaches, not just the proposed method.
- Inspect existing code, docs and CI; research unfamiliar technologies. Prefer native capabilities, established libraries, secure APIs, automation and mobile/cloud-first workflows over reinvention.
- Preserve existing functionality, design, signing, identifiers and update compatibility. Find root causes, test edge cases, avoid unrelated changes and ask before destructive, costly, major or security-sensitive decisions.
- Protect secrets and use least privilege. Minimize AI usage, build quotas, dependencies and manual work. Automate repetitive tasks with deterministic tools.
- When authorized, inspect, plan, implement, test, commit, build, verify and release using existing processes. Report actual verification, limitations, commits, versions and browser links; do not claim runtime testing from compilation alone.
<!-- end topgun1111-engineering-policy -->
